questions.q: What is the essay's main argument?
options: Procrastination can be cured by keeping a disciplined, well-organized to-do list
Procrastination is inevitable, so the aim is to procrastinate well, on big work
Interruptions are harmless to deep work as long as they are kept short
Ambitious people should avoid big problems and focus on small errands
questions.explain: The author says you can't avoid procrastination, only choose to put off errands for more important work.

questions.q: What are the three variants of procrastination described?
options: Planning the work, delaying the work, or abandoning the work entirely
Starting early, finishing late, or never starting the task at all
Working on errands, attending meetings, or checking email constantly
Working on nothing, something less important, or something more important
questions.explain: Type (a) nothing, (b) something less important, (c) something more important, which is the good kind.

questions.q: Why does the author think startups are most productive at the beginning?
options: There is nobody around yet to interrupt them
They have the most funding they will ever see
Customers demand much less of them early on
Founders are at their youngest and most energetic
questions.explain: He says the main reason may be that there's no one to interrupt a couple of guys in an apartment.

questions.q: What three questions does Richard Hamming suggest asking?
options: What do you enjoy most, what pays best, what is easiest to finish
Who are your competitors, what do they do, how can you beat them
Which problems in your field matter most, are you on one, why not
What did you finish today, was it useful, what should come next
questions.explain: Hamming asked about the field's most important problems, whether you work on one, and why not.

questions.q: What solution to procrastination does the author finally suggest?
options: Schedule your hardest work in short, strict daily time slices
Let delight pull you rather than a to-do list push you
Hire assistants to handle your errands so you can focus
Work on easier problems first to build early momentum daily
questions.explain: He ends by saying to let delight pull you, working on an ambitious project you enjoy.
